title: MOCA trust root
description: Host-supplied: which keys and Sigstore identities a host trusts, and for what. See spec/moca-attestations.md section 6.

roles.description: What the key may attest. Required; an empty list trusts the key for nothing.

ids.description: Package ids this entry may speak for in supersedes and conflictsWith relations: exact ids, or prefixes ending in /, : or # (package spec §7.2).

reviewers.description: The reviewers (OKF actors) this entry may sign reviews as. Without it, any (attestations §4).

trustedRoot.description: A Sigstore trusted root (trusted_root.json from sigstore/protobuf-specs): the Fulcio, Rekor, CT log and timestamp keys to verify against, offline. Attestations section 6.

issuer.description: Matched exactly against the certificate's OIDC issuer.

subject.description: Matched exactly against the certificate's subject alternative name (email or URI).

roles.description: What the identity may attest. Required; an empty list trusts it for nothing.

ids.description: Package ids this entry may speak for in supersedes and conflictsWith relations: exact ids, or prefixes ending in /, : or # (package spec §7.2).

reviewers.description: The reviewers (OKF actors) this entry may sign reviews as. Without it, any (attestations §4).
